body:
So I sell Datura seeds online, I was blowing the debris off some seeds, with my eyes closed. Yet a tiny flake of leaf still managed to make it into my eye. thinking nothing of it I rubbed it out of my eye. Then about 20 minutes later it felt like it was still in there, I went to the mirror to see if I could find it. Shit the joke was on me, my pupil was fixed and dilated.
Forgetting what had been in my eye (probably because I was three quarters of the way through a joint), I panicked and started surfing for causes, most seemed like really bad shit, then I noticed mind-altering substances was a cause and the leaf dawned on me.
As I started to calm down it started to sneak up on me within 3hrs I peaked I was high as fuck. It was like a mushroom high without hallucinations, I came down about a few hours later. It has been 12hrs now and my pupil is still huge, I've read that when ingested it can take quite a while for your pupils to go back to normal. Which begs the question; how long for a dose in the fucking eye? And yeah this is my first experience.
